test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The sharpshooter ________ dead a man-eating tiger after it allegedly killed nine people in the last few days.
solution:
The correct answer is '**shot**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**shot**" is the correct choice as it precisely describes what a sharpshooter does — firing a gun or similar weapon at a target.
 
• The phrase "**shot dead**" is an established collocation used to indicate that someone has been killed by gunfire.
 
• Words like "**fixed**", "**threw**", or "**killed**" do not fit naturally in this expression, especially in the context of a sharpshooter's action.
 
• Hence, "**shot dead**" is the most appropriate and idiomatic phrase for this sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The sharpshooter **shot**__ dead a man-eating tiger after it allegedly killed nine people in the last few days.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Shot dead**: A common phrase used in reports and news to refer to someone being fatally shot.
 
• **Sharpshooter**: A person who is extremely skilled at shooting targets, usually using firearms.
